verdict.rationale: Motion's meeting-assistant page says it turns Outlook, Google and iCloud calendar accounts into one interface and pairs this directly with a 'Never get double-booked' promise. That covers multi-provider connection plus conflict prevention. The evidence is only marketing-level, though. Missing for 10: documentation of how conflict checking works across every connected calendar (sync frequency, which events block availability), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can connect several calendars (Google, Outlook, Apple) and every one is checked for conflicts so I never get double-booked

citations.quote: Turn all of your calendar accounts—Outlook, Google, iCloud—into one single interface. Never get double-booked
Combine all your calendars in one view.
